'''''The Paths to Power''''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Book/Legends|treatise]]<ref name="Imperial Warlords" /> written by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Special Inaugural Edition" /> The text topped the best&ndash;seller lists on [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after<ref name="Date" /> [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]]. The release of ''The Paths to Power'' was later included in a listing of Palpatine's triumphs included in the [[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241|Inaugural Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], celebrating Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|ascension]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]<ref name="Special Inaugural Edition" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] <ref name="Date" /> The text was considered a modern masterpiece in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Imperial Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during which [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] had it highly ranked on his reading list.<ref name="Imperial Warlords" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Paths to Power'' was first mentioned in the [[in-universe]] article, ''[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]'',<ref name="Special Inaugural Edition" /> published on [[September 26]], [[2005]]<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> in [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-forth issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''.<ref name="Special Inaugural Edition" /> The book was created by author [[Daniel Wallace]], who later noted on his blog that it was but one example of Palpatine's career as a writer, as the Emperor had been established as the author of the ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]'' in the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series.<ref name="Dan">{{Blog|danwallace|25|HoloNet News: The Annotated Edition}}</ref>
